topic: 浏览器导航与 HTTP 重定向
title: 实现安全的 HTTP 跳转追踪：保留方法并隔离跨源凭据
source: 飞书《60》技术问题改编并纠错
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
body:
## 环境与初始材料
普通用户 Linux + Python3 标准库；提供函数骨架，验收启动两个真实回环 HTTP 端口，构造相对跳转、跨源后返回、循环及错误状态。仅练习 HTTP 跳转层，未启用 TLS，不将回环明文环境作为生产凭据传输方案，也不访问公网。

## 操作任务
实现 execute(url,output,method="GET",body=b"",headers=None,max_redirects=5)，实际执行有限 HTTP 跳转并生成 JSON 跟踪工件。仅支持无用户信息的数字回环 HTTP URL、GET/POST、bytes请求体；最多0～5次跳转且拒绝布尔。301/302将POST转GET，303转GET并清请求体与Content-Type；307/308保留方法/体。相对Location按当前URL解析，fragment不得上网；同源保留Authorization，跨源即永久剥离，不能跳回原源后自动恢复。仅接收Authorization/Content-Type/User-Agent输入头，拒绝重复大小写字段/控制字符/其他头。循环、缺Location、非回环目标、响应超过256KiB均失败且保留旧输出；无跳转的401等状态原样记录，不自动重试认证。每次连接/读采用0.5秒空闲超时，不把它宣称为整链路总期限。

## 提交产物
task.py，以及函数原子生成的 JSON 文件：history 的每项含 url/method/status，最终 status 与 body_base64；函数返回同一对象。不将 Authorization 值写入跟踪工件，不修改调用方 headers；所有连接和临时文件必须回收。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py 通过真实HTTP服务端记录请求方法、二进制体、头与端口，核对307/308、303/302、同源/跨源凭据边界、返回原源不恢复凭据、片段移除、错误输入无请求、响应上限、循环/跳数限制、401不重试、失败不覆盖和FD回收。全部断言通过退出0；不以预制报告代替实际请求。

失败示例：跨到第二端口时仍携带 Authorization，服务器会收到本不属于它的凭据，验收失败。
rubric: 可能先命中浏览器/系统缓存，否则经解析器取得地址；选择路径并建立TCP+TLS或QUIC连接，校验证书和目标身份，发送包含Host/authority的HTTP请求
入口代理、应用及依赖处理后响应，浏览器继续请求资源并渲染
代理、缓存、重用连接和HTTP版本会改变步骤，排查应分阶段记录耗时

exercise.verification: 两个真实回环HTTP服务端记录请求；核对方法/体/凭据作用域与产物，拒绝路径和FD清理
failure_examples: 跨源继续转发 Authorization 导致凭据泄漏

test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,sys,json,base64,threading,http.server,contextlib,urllib.parse,os
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
import task
requests=[];other_url=''
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self,*args):pass
    def do_POST(self):self.do_GET()
    def do_GET(self):
        body=self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')))
        requests.append({'path':self.path,'method':self.command,'body':body,'auth':self.headers.get('Authorization'),'type':self.headers.get('Content-Type'),'port':self.server.server_port})
        p=urllib.parse.urlsplit(self.path).path
        status=200;location=None;reply=b'ok\x00binary'
        if p=='/post':status=307;location='/finish?q=1#section'
        elif p=='/see-other':status=303;location='/finish'
        elif p=='/legacy':status=302;location='/finish'
        elif p=='/legacy301':status=301;location='/finish'
        elif p=='/cross':status=308;location=other_url+'/return'
        elif p=='/return':status=307;location=first_url+'/finish'
        elif p=='/same':status=301;location='/finish'
        elif p=='/loop':status=302;location='/loop'
        elif p=='/hop':status=302;location='/same'
        elif p=='/missing':status=302
        elif p=='/unsafe':status=302;location='http://192.0.2.99:1234/'
        elif p=='/userinfo':status=302;location='http://user:pass@127.0.0.1/'
        elif p=='/big':reply=b'x'*262145
        elif p=='/denied':status=401;reply=b'denied'
        self.send_response(status)
        if location:self.send_header('Location',location)
        self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(reply)));self.end_headers()
        try:self.wfile.write(reply)
        except (BrokenPipeError,ConnectionResetError):pass
@contextlib.contextmanager
def server():
    s=http.server.HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler);t=threading.Thread(target=lambda:s.serve_forever(poll_interval=.01));t.start()
    try:yield 'http://127.0.0.1:'+str(s.server_port)
    finally:s.shutdown();s.server_close();t.join(1);assert not t.is_alive()
baseline=len(os.listdir('/proc/self/fd'))
with server() as first_url,server() as other_url:
    def run(path,method='GET',body=b'',headers=None,limit=5):
        requests.clear();r=task.execute(first_url+path,'trace.json',method,body,headers,limit)
        assert r==json.loads(pathlib.Path('trace.json').read_text())
        assert not list(pathlib.Path('.').glob('.trace-*'))
        return r,list(requests)
    headers={'Authorization':'Bearer private-token','Content-Type':'application/octet-stream'}
    snapshot=dict(headers)
    r,rows=run('/post','POST',b'payload\x00',headers)
    assert [(x['method'],x['path'],x['body']) for x in rows]==[('POST','/post',b'payload\x00'),('POST','/finish?q=1',b'payload\x00')]
    assert all(x['auth']=='Bearer private-token' for x in rows)
    assert [x['status'] for x in r['history']]==[307,200]
    assert base64.b64decode(r['body_base64'])==b'ok\x00binary'
    assert headers==snapshot and 'private-token' not in pathlib.Path('trace.json').read_text()
    for path in ['/see-other','/legacy','/legacy301']:
        _,rows=run(path,'POST',b'data',headers)
        assert rows[1]['method']=='GET' and rows[1]['body']==b'' and rows[1]['type'] is None
    r,rows=run('/cross','POST',b'kept',headers)
    assert [x['auth'] for x in rows]==['Bearer private-token',None,None],rows
    assert all(x['method']=='POST' and x['body']==b'kept' for x in rows)
    _,rows=run('/same',headers=headers);assert rows[-1]['auth']=='Bearer private-token'
    r,rows=run('/denied',headers=headers);assert r['status']==401 and len(rows)==1
    for path,limit in [('/loop',5),('/hop',1),('/missing',5),('/unsafe',5),('/userinfo',5),('/big',5),('/same',0)]:
        pathlib.Path('trace.json').write_text('KEEP');requests.clear()
        try:task.execute(first_url+path,'trace.json',max_redirects=limit)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('invalid redirect/response accepted: '+path)
        assert pathlib.Path('trace.json').read_text()=='KEEP'
        assert not list(pathlib.Path('.').glob('.trace-*'))
        if path in {'/unsafe','/userinfo'}:assert len(requests)==1
    for bad in [{'Host':'evil'},{'Authorization':'x\r\nInjected: y'},{'Authorization':'a','authorization':'b'}]:
        requests.clear()
        try:task.execute(first_url+'/finish','trace.json',headers=bad)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('unsafe input header accepted')
        assert not requests
    for limit in [-1,6,True]:
        try:task.execute(first_url+'/finish','trace.json',max_redirects=limit)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('unsafe redirect bound accepted')

    requests.clear()
    for url in ['http://127.0.0.1:0/','http://127.0.0.1:99999/','https://127.0.0.1/','http://localhost/','http://a:b@127.0.0.1/','http://127.0.0.1/\r\nbad']:
        pathlib.Path('trace.json').write_text('KEEP')
        try:task.execute(url,'trace.json')
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('unsafe initial URL accepted: '+repr(url))
        assert pathlib.Path('trace.json').read_text()=='KEEP'
    assert not requests

assert len(os.listdir('/proc/self/fd'))==baseline,'HTTP connections leaked'
print('PASS: actual redirect method/body semantics, authorization origin boundary, binary trace and bounded hops')
